title: LineageMark: Multi-user White-box Watermarking for Contribution Tracing in Model Derivation Chains
abstract: arXiv:2606.17123v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In open large language model (LLM) ecosystems, models are frequently adapted across multiple domains and applications, forming multi-stage derivation chains. Consequently, tracking and verifying historical contributions is essential for model provenance and intellectual property protection. However, existing watermarking methods are mainly designed for single-user, one-time embeddings, often fail under repeated model derivation and incremental updates. To address this problem, we propose LineageMark, a multi-user white-box watermarking framework for model derivation chains. The framework encodes watermarks in model parameters using a projection-based approach. Stable carriers are first selected to reduce sensitivity to model changes, each watermark bit is then represented as a projection statistic over these carriers. translated_title: LineageMark：用于模型派生链贡献追踪的多用户白盒水印框架
translated_abstract: 在开放的大语言模型生态系统中，模型经常被跨多个领域和应用进行适配，形成多阶段的派生链。因此，追踪和验证历史贡献对于模型溯源和知识产权保护至关重要。然而，现有的水印方法主要针对单用户、一次性嵌入设计，在反复的模型派生和增量更新下往往失效。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LineageMark，一个面向模型派生链的多用户白盒水印框架。该框架使用基于投影的方法将水印编码在模型参数中。首先选择稳定的载体以降低对模型变化的敏感性，随后将每个水印位表示为这些载体上的投影统计量。额外的水印插入仅在投影空间中引入有界的扰动，并通过边距约束……
tldr: 提出了LineageMark——一个面向模型派生链的多用户白盒水印框架，通过基于投影的参数编码方式，在多阶段模型派生和增量更新场景下实现多方历史贡献的追踪与验证。
